items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: I had George Reynolds on the piano.

ctx.x: With your own band, Uptown band? Yeah, well I made it before 20, that's before 26. The Lovey Austin, the hardest dog.
Yeah, I never called it Lovey Austin, see that's wrong. That's wrong too? Yeah, that's wrong. I had George Reynolds on the piano. Where was he from? St. Louis.
That must be the one that Jolly Roll played against.
